class.name: DrapeDriverModifier3D
class.brief_description: Turns spring chains' top joints with the thighs, and hands a shader the legs' capsules.
class.description: Run ahead of a [SpringBoneSimulator3D] whose chains hang from the hips, as a skirt's columns do. Each pass it turns every chain's top joint by its weights of the two thighs' swings from rest, following a swing that would carry the top inward reversed; past a [DrapeRingsModifier3D]'s stretch limit it follows harder (the hold). While [member seated], it turns the chains outward over a seat and lifts the lap's. Last, it sets the legs' capsules, in a [GeometryInstance3D]'s space, as that instance's [code]drape_leg_N_a[/code] and [code]drape_leg_N_b[/code] shader parameters. The layout is given by [method set_layout] and [method set_legs_layout]. It skips the physics tick's pass unless the tree is paused.

method.name: clear_layout
method.description: Removes the chains' layout; the modifier then does nothing.

method.name: clear_pose_targets
method.description: Removes the pose targets given by [method set_pose_targets].

method.name: compute_leg_capsules
method.description: The legs' capsules in [param wardrobe]'s space for [param skeleton]'s current pose: per capsule, one end and its radius, then the other end and its radius. The thighs (the first two) are zero while [member seated].

method.name: compute_seated_hips
method.description: The transform taking a seated target's vertex, in [param wardrobe]'s mesh data with the hips at rest, to where the skinned mesh is: by [param bind] to [param skeleton]'s space, carried from [param bone]'s rest to its pose, then into [param wardrobe]'s space.

method.name: reset_springs_in_pass
method.description: Has the next pass reset the springs given by [method set_springs_node] once it has set the chains' tops.

method.name: set_layout
method.description: Sets the chains. [param thighs] are the two thigh bones, with their rest rotations (quaternions as [code](x, y, z, w)[/code]) and their directions towards the knees. Per chain: its top bone ([code]-1[/code] to skip it), its rest rotation, its full share and its weights of each thigh [code](left, right)[/code], the way it hangs and the way out of the body, its turn over a seat, and how much of the lap it is. Directions are in the hips' frame, as is [param up].

method.name: set_legs_layout
method.description: Sets the legs' capsules: per capsule its bone ([code]-1[/code] for none), its two ends in that bone's frame, and the radius at each end.

method.name: set_pose_targets
method.description: Sets the pose targets: every chain bone and its rest rotation, then per pose variant each bone's rotation in that pose (all of one variant's bones, then the next's) and the variant's four leg angles in radians (each thigh's swing forward from rest, left then right, seen from the side in the hips' frame, then each knee's bend from rest). [param knees] are the two knee bones, with their rest rotations and their directions towards the feet; [param hips_rest] is the hips' rest rotation in the skeleton's space. Call it after [method set_layout], which clears it. Each pass, while the [SpringBoneSimulator3D] given by [method set_springs_node] is active, the variant the legs are furthest into ([method weigh_pose]) turns every bone towards its target that far; a chain's top is turned from where the thighs and the seat put it, less as far as the seat presses it.

method.name: set_pose_tuning
method.description: The [code]from[/code] and [code]stray[/code] the pass gives [method weigh_pose].

method.name: set_rings_node
method.description: The [DrapeRingsModifier3D] whose stretch drives the hold; [code]null[/code] for none.

method.name: set_seat_turns
method.description: Replaces the layout's seat turns (one quaternion per column, as [method set_layout] takes them), so a driver can turn its columns one way on a seat and another on a bed. With them, per column, the share of its follow of the thighs and of its lap lift that being seated takes away, so a column laid along the seat stays there; none given, a seat takes none.

method.name: set_seated_hips
method.description: Each pass, sets [param wardrobe]'s [code]drape_hips_0[/code] to [code]drape_hips_2[/code] instance uniforms to the rows of [method compute_seated_hips], for the wardrobe shader's seated target. A [param bone] of [code]-1[/code] sets nothing.

method.name: set_tuning
method.description: The stretch past which the hold comes in, the share of an inward swing followed reversed, the lap's lift in radians when fully seated, the stretch past [param max_stretch] (as a share of it) at which the hold is full, and the seconds the hold takes to come and go.

method.name: set_wardrobe_node
method.description: The [GeometryInstance3D] given the legs' capsules each pass; [code]null[/code] for none.

method.name: side_angle
method.description: [param v]'s angle forward of straight down, seen from the side: [code]atan2(v.z, -v.y)[/code].

method.name: weigh_pose
method.description: How far leg angles [param legs] are into the pose a variant was recorded at, [param variant], from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]: [code]t = legs·variant / variant·variant[/code], smoothstepped from [param from] to [code]1[/code], times how close [param legs] stay to [code]t * variant[/code], fading as that distance over [param variant]'s length goes from [param stray] to twice it.

members.member: Per chain, how far its top followed each thigh on the last drawn pass, negative where the swing was followed reversed.
How much extra follow the hold added on the last drawn pass, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].
The legs' angles on the last drawn pass, as [method set_pose_targets] takes a variant's; empty without pose targets.
The pose variant whose targets the last drawn pass turned towards, or [code]-1[/code] for none.
How far the last drawn pass turned towards [member pose_variant]'s targets, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].
How far into a seat the wearer is, from [code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code].
Per chain, how far its top follows each thigh at rest, as [method set_layout] gave it.
